blocks.html: Appliances and equipment that are not to be included in the test shall be either disconnected from the piping or isolated by blanks, blind flanges or caps. Flanged joints at which blinds are inserted to blank off other equipment during the test shall not be required to be tested. The affected piping and joints shall be checked with a noncorrosive leak-detecting fluid or other approved leak-detecting methods when gas is energized.
